svg.text: Where each style smokes on the 4 main maps
All classes. Each line is one smoke as laid, the dot is its centre. Own spawn at the bottom (north-spawn teams mirrored north-south).
Long smoke, early, for a teammate: H-SR, RESIN, BONKZ
Cruiser smoke, selfish, stationary: HTDOG, VRTUS
KITE (nearer the long-smoke style; small n, shown for reference only)
Land of Fire: 9 smokes, 3 games (small n)
